text:
Sam CSM: quick one — Lyra wants final signoff for their private/VPC deploy.
Sam CSM: items security flagged: NAT egress rules, cross-account IAM for our audit role, customer-managed KMS key policy, and audit log forwarding to their Splunk.
Raj Infra: thanks — I reviewed their network layout. they have a 10.40.0.0/16 VPC, public NAT in two AZs. we should recommend VPC endpoints for S3 and KMS (no internet egress for logs).
Raj Infra: suggested SGs — allow outbound 443 to Splunk collector IPs (listed in their ticket), limit egress to our control plane CIDRs for checks. example:
Raj Infra: ```text
# egress (example)
allow tcp:443 to 34.120.88.12/32
allow tcp:443 to 34.120.88.13/32
deny all else
```
Elaine CS: noted. Lyra asked about retention and whether logs land in their account or ours. they require logs retained 400 days and stored in their S3 bucket encrypted with a CMK.
Raj Infra: for KMS: create alias `alias/redwood/lyra-prod`, key policy must allow their security account to decrypt and our platform role to encrypt/decrypt for delivery. propose minimal key policy with explicit cross-account principals.
Raj Infra: sample assume-role trust for our audit role:
Raj Infra: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDWOOD_ACCOUNT_ID:role/redwood-audit-role"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {}
    }
  ]
}
```
Mika SE: pinging infra — can we get the KMS policy reviewed by security before we hand off? also need confirmation that their Splunk endpoint supports TLS mutual auth (they indicated yes, but we need cert exchange process).
Elaine CS: I already asked them for the Splunk cert thumbprint and the bucket ARN. waiting on reply from their security lead (Olivia).
Sam CSM: timeline: Lyra wants cutover next Tue. without the KMS policy signed and log forwarding validated we should delay. can we do a dry-run for the log pipeline on Monday?
Raj Infra: yes. i can stand up a dry-run: steps — create CMK with alias, attach key policy allowing redwood-audit-role, create S3 bucket in their acct (they'll provision) with bucket policy to allow PutObject from our forwarder role, configure VPC endpoint to avoid NAT, and send sample logs. estimate 2–3 hours if certs and bucket ARN are available.
Mika SE: i'll schedule canary window Mon 09:00–12:00 PT and invite Lyra. please @Sam CSM add Olivia and their infra contact to the invite.
Sam CSM: done. invited Olivia and infra@lyra.com. also added security@redwood for key review.
DeployBot: deploy:log-forwarder build #568 promoted to staging at 2026-03-22T14:23:05Z :rocket:
Elaine CS: small ask — retention lifecycle: put a 90-day hot tier then move to glacier/deep archive to meet 400 days cost-effectively. i'll include that in the runbook.
Sam CSM: action items:
Sam CSM: 1) Raj — prepare KMS policy draft and trust ARN, test dry-run Mon 09:00 PT (involves infra+security) @Raj Infra
Sam CSM: 2) Mika — run canary window and capture perf/latency of forwarder @Mika SE
Sam CSM: 3) Elaine — confirm bucket ARN + cert thumbprint from Lyra, finalize retention plan @Elaine CS
Sam CSM: 4) Olivia (Lyra) — provide Splunk collector IPs, certs, and bucket access
Sam CSM: if all green we cutover Tue afternoon. :thumbsup:
